body: T11b — the inference chain, second slice of the T11 umbrella (architecture contract: .adlc/specs/T11.md). Owns AC1 (real LLM handler: Moonshot kimi-k3, MOONSHOT_API_KEY, zero new deps, stdlib :httpc/:ssl, stub-adapter test + one live call), AC3 (re-boot idempotence WITH the LLM handler — the pointer guarantee: frozen pointers over the immutable store, crash-window test asserts one request + one response + a counted skip), AC4 (THE operational run: Hermes boots daemon on tmp store/keyring, CLI-ingests a real question, context builder fires, model answers, message.sent persists, vault renders, SIGTERM, re-boot, no duplicate — recorded as acceptance evidence), AC5 (store-as-memory: grounded follow-up 'what did I just say?' references the first exchange), AC8 (tool chains as cascades of linked deltas: ToolCall -> executor -> ToolResult -> Response, emitted as they happen, mid-chain restart resumes from the chain, projection is a lens — collapsed and expanded views of the same store), AC9 (T10 deterministic loop untouched), plus AC10 gates. Deliverables: Kyber.Agent.LlmHandler, Kyber.Agent.ContextBuilder (session hyperview + window lens + memory injection via the MemoryPort seam — a retriever interface, NOT a concrete memory container; T11c slots the real container behind it), Kyber.Agent.Engine (stateful turn holder, pointer-walk rehydration), tool executor handler(s), CLI kyber agent, memory_port.ex. Gate: the operational run with a REAL Moonshot call recorded; mix test green; T10 tests untouched; rails-guard clean; no Process.sleep.
title: T11b: the inference chain — LLM handler + context builder + engine + tool chains (the agent lives in it)
